text: Might be overreacting here. My niece is staying with me, she's 10, and her temp is 39.5 which I think is quite high? She's got a runny, blocked nose, lots of sneezing and a bit of a cough, nothing big. No fits or shaking or anything like that, and her breathing seems fine, normal I'd say. Probably just a cold but I'm not used to looking after her when she's poorly so thought I'd ask
